proofs/mc1/NobleContractImpl/Funs.lean.rationale: Every theorem these two handwritten modules declare is a root. The theorem names themselves are read from the compiled environment by closure.lean, never listed here, so adding a theorem does not need an edit to this file and no root can be silently forgotten. Changing which modules count is a deliberate, reviewed change.

proofs/m3/NobleKernel/Funs.lean.rationale: Every theorem NobleM2.Refinement declares is a root of the M3 (kernel embedding) subject. links.mjs fails if a closure declares a scope this file does not review, so a run cannot widen its own root set.
